entries.title: Structural detail S-04: party wall junction
entries.text: Party wall junction S-04: 90mm staggered studs at 450mm centres, 75mm acoustic insulation between rows.

entries.title: Lender drawdown stages and evidence
entries.text: Lender stages: Slab, Frame, Lock-up, Fixing, Handover. A Frame claim needs the certifier's frame inspection certificate and dated photos. A Fixing claim needs the wet area waterproofing record and dated photos.

entries.title: Elm Ridge claim register
entries.text: Elm Ridge Frame claim: frame photos filed (14 dated photos); certifier frame inspection booked, certificate not yet received.

entries.title: Wet area waterproofing standard
entries.text: Wet areas follow AS 3740 (Waterproofing of domestic wet areas): liquid membrane, bond-breaker at wall-floor junctions, puddle flange at the floor waste. Photograph each before screed for the certifier.

entries.title: Purchase order PO-1187, concrete
entries.text: PO-1187: 18 m3 32MPa concrete for Elm Ridge slab, supplier Harbour Readymix (fictional). Code to 2100 Substructure – Concrete.

entries.title: Variation rule
entries.text: No change to scope starts on site until a written variation, with cost and time impact, is signed by the client. Structural changes go to the engineer first.
